subject: Boston Avenue Redevelopment and Riverside Electric Fence
overview: The board reviewed and approved amendments to a major mixed-use project on Boston Avenue and granted a variance for a high-security electric fence on Riverside Avenue. All petitions heard during the session were approved unanimously.

items.title: 290 Salem Street LLC
items.summary: Continued the petition to construct a seven-unit residential structure to the November 30th meeting to allow the applicant time to coordinate with the planning department.

items.title: 590 Boston Avenue Amendments
items.summary: Approved amendments to a previously granted variance and site plan for a five-story mixed-use building, which included increasing residential units from 40 to 45 and moving parking to an at-grade configuration. The board adopted conditions recommended by the Community Development Board, excluding a proposed land donation that was deemed procedurally ineligible due to public noticing requirements.

items.title: 436 Riverside Avenue Electric Fence
items.summary: Approved a special permit to waive the requirement for police chief sign-off on a security plan and granted a height variance for a 10-foot-high electric fence at a Penske facility. The board determined that the proposed system, which includes a non-electrified outer perimeter and industry-standard emergency shut-offs for first responders, did not pose a threat to public safety.

items.title: 277 Middlesex Avenue Prestige Car Wash
items.summary: Approved a special permit to modify a non-conforming car wash use by installing three automated pay stations to improve on-site traffic flow. The board found the modification would reduce vehicle queuing on public streets and would not be detrimental to the neighborhood.

items.title: Administrative Updates
items.summary: Staff discussed upcoming 40B comprehensive permit filings for Front Street and a pending executive session to discuss litigation regarding a separate housing project.
